applicabilityBasis.summary: gtUSDTp represents proportional USDT lending-vault shares in Morpho Vault V2. Shares accrue investment yield at a variable asset-per-share exchange rate and redeem into underlying digital assets subject to liquidity. The reviewed materials present a strategy position without a fixed monetary-value issuer redemption obligation or a fixed-value payment-token design.

references.label: Morpho: proportional vault shares and ERC-4626 mechanics
Morpho: Vault V2 lending strategies and liquidity

genius.notes: Assessment applies to the vault share separately from underlying USDT. GENIUS Act section 2(22) requires a payment/settlement design, an issuer obligation to redeem for fixed monetary value, and a stable-value representation. The reviewed strategy-vault mechanics support the non-payment-token category. No GENIUS authorization, foreign registration or issuer-specific regulator finding is asserted. Gauntlet is identified as curator; the opened product materials do not establish a separate legal token issuer, so issuerEntity and issuerDomicile are omitted. Underlying-token reserve attestations and issuer licenses are not attributed to this vault.
